_meta.purpose: Pre-resolved registry values for downstream agents. Agents consuming this file do NOT need to load raw registry files.

spec_identity.notes: New spec family for exterior trim prime+paint (fascia, rake, frieze, corner boards, band boards, window casings, door casings, sills). Context prefix XTRM (eXterior TRiM) — no collision with existing prefixes. Interior trim uses TRIM_ prefix. Combined prime+finish in single spec (same mobilization). 8 paintable items, all LF-based. 3 substrate materials (wood, PVC, composite) with different primer paths.

paintable_items.name: Exterior fascia board
paintable_items.notes: Fascia board at roofline. Always elevated. LF measurement along roofline perimeter.

paintable_items.name: Exterior rake board
paintable_items.notes: Rake board along gable edge. Inclined and elevated. LF measurement along gable slope.

paintable_items.name: Exterior frieze board
paintable_items.notes: Frieze board at eave junction. Surface ref ext_trim_frieze exists in registry surface_ids.

paintable_items.name: Exterior corner boards
paintable_items.notes: Corner boards — vertical, two faces per board (inside/outside corner). Surface ref ext_trim_corner exists in registry surface_ids.

paintable_items.name: Exterior band board
paintable_items.notes: Band board between floors. Horizontal run similar to frieze.

paintable_items.name: Exterior window casing
paintable_items.notes: Window casing perimeter. Surface ref ext_trim_window_casing exists in registry surface_ids. Distinct from interior ITM_TRIM_CASING_WINDOW.

paintable_items.name: Exterior door casing
paintable_items.notes: Door casing perimeter. Surface ref ext_trim_door_casing exists in registry surface_ids. Distinct from interior ITM_TRIM_CASING_DOOR.

paintable_items.name: Exterior window sill
paintable_items.notes: Window sill — horizontal, direct weather exposure. Most vulnerable trim component. May receive additional coat or high-durability coating.

task_prefix.collision_check: No collision. Existing prefixes: CLOSET_SHELF, FRAME, DOOR, CEIL, WALL, TRIM (interior), WIN, STRS, WNSC, WDWL, WDCL, ARCH, BLTN, CABT, SDNG, FCSD. XTRM is unique.
task_prefix.naming_rule: TSK_XTRM_{ACTION} — action should be verb-based. Examples: TSK_XTRM_SAND_PREP_WOOD, TSK_XTRM_SCUFF_SAND_PVC, TSK_XTRM_PRIME_BRUSH, TSK_XTRM_CAULK_JOINTS, TSK_XTRM_FINISH_BRUSH_1, TSK_XTRM_SAND_INTERCOAT

expected_modules.notes: Protection setup — landscape, hardscape, light fixtures, glass masking for casings
Sand wood (80-120 grit) or scuff-sand PVC (220 grit + acetone wipe) or edge-seal composite. Knot spot-prime on tannin-rich species.
Full prime — 3 substrate paths: acrylic (wood/composite), bonding (PVC), alkyd spot-prime (tannin knots). Conditional on SS_EXT_BARE_WOOD.
Caulk trim joints AFTER primer (RC-003). Caulk adheres better to primed surfaces. Sequenced between prime and finish modules but phase is prep (caulking is preparation for finish coats).
First finish coat — brush (default) or spray for long runs
QT4: light sand between coats. QT5: hand-sand with raking light inspection.

quality_tier.notes: QT2 excluded — not applicable to exterior trim per Application_Methods_Doctrine Part B §7. Exterior trim is standard exterior grade but its visible architectural role justifies minimum QT3.

application_method.notes: Brush is PRIMARY default for trim (precision, detail). Spray is secondary — only for long continuous runs (fascia, frieze, band board) where masking is economical. Unlike siding where spray is primary.

sheen.notes: No locked-in default sheen (RC-004). Sheen is always a project-level user selection. Satin is most common in practice. Gloss highlights surface defects — requires better prep.

phase.notes: Combined prime+finish spec. No 'apply' phase — uses 'prime' and 'finish' directly. Caulk module uses 'prep' phase (caulking is preparation for finish coats, sequenced after prime).

unit_of_measure.notes: LF is primary UOM for all 8 trim items. EA for protection item counts and knot spot-prime counts. FIXED for tool cleaning. No SF direct — PCA P10 one-foot rule (1 SF per LF for girth <12 in) is embedded in production rate calibration.

substrate_state.notes: NC trim is either bare (all 3 substrate materials — PVC and composite are 'bare' in sense of no field coating) or field-primed (primer already applied). The substrate_material dimension determines which primer system is used. SS_EXT_PAINTED_GLOSS is a proposed new output state.

product_role.notes: Specialty for solar-reflective PVC coating (VinylSafe). No sealer/clear/stain needed.

protection_level.notes: Edge_only for landscape. Light_mask for glass, hardscape, fixtures. Full_mask for siding adjacent to spray trim application.

surface_ids.notes: ext_trim_frieze, ext_trim_corner, ext_trim_window_casing, ext_trim_door_casing, siding_field, soffit_field, foundation_wall exist in registry. ext_trim_fascia, ext_trim_rake, ext_trim_band, ext_sill are proposed additions.

existing_systems_to_consider: SYS_EXT_WOOD_PRIMER_ACRYLIC — similar acrylic primer but siding-specific context
SYS_EXT_WOOD_PRIMER_BONDING — bonding primer for existing coatings on wood, different use case than PVC bonding
SYS_EXT_WOOD_FINISH_STANDARD — siding finish, same tier concept
SYS_EXT_WOOD_FINISH_PREMIUM — siding finish, same tier concept
SYS_PRIMER_BONDING — interior bonding primer, different substrate

proposed_systems.name: Exterior Acrylic Latex Primer for Wood/Composite Trim
proposed_systems.notes: 100% acrylic exterior primer for wood and composite trim. Edge seal included for composite field-cut edges.

proposed_systems.name: Bonding Primer for PVC Trim
proposed_systems.notes: Grips dense non-porous PVC surface. Mandatory for PVC trim. Scuff-sand glossy surfaces first with 220-grit.

proposed_systems.name: Alkyd/Shellac Spot Primer for Tannin Knots
proposed_systems.notes: Spot-applied to visible knots on tannin-rich species (cedar, redwood, fir) before full acrylic primer coat. Not a full-surface system.

proposed_systems.name: Standard Exterior Acrylic Trim Paint
proposed_systems.notes: Mid-grade 100% acrylic exterior trim paint. Sheen per project selection (satin/semi-gloss/gloss).

proposed_systems.name: Premium Exterior Acrylic-Urethane Trim Paint
proposed_systems.notes: Premium acrylic-urethane blend (SW Emerald Urethane Trim Enamel, BM Aura Grand Entrance). Enhanced hardness and scratch resistance. Sheen per project selection.

proposed_systems.name: Solar-Reflective Trim Paint for PVC
proposed_systems.notes: REQUIRED when PVC substrate AND color LRV < 55. VinylSafe/Colors for Vinyl technology. HARD STOP — standard dark paint on PVC voids warranty and causes thermal distortion.

material_system_prefix.notes: 3 substrate-driven primers (acrylic for wood/composite, bonding for PVC, alkyd spot for tannin knots) + 2 QT-driven finish systems + 1 conditional solar-reflective system for PVC dark colors. Exterior trim is NOT fine-finish (no SYS_FF_ prefix) — standard exterior grade (RC-007).

proposed_consumables.name: Exterior Flexible Trim Caulk
proposed_consumables.notes: Polyurethane or siliconized acrylic for trim joints. NEVER silicone on PVC. Solvent-based polymer (NPC Solar Seal #900, OSI Quad) or polyurethane for PVC joints.

proposed_consumables.name: 80-Grit Sandpaper for Wood Mill Glaze
proposed_consumables.notes: Remove mill glaze from new wood trim. 80-120 grit range.

proposed_consumables.name: Acetone/Denatured Alcohol for PVC Prep
proposed_consumables.notes: Wipe cut edges of PVC trim to seal open cells and remove static charge.

proposed_consumables.name: Airless Spray Tip 211 (trim detail)
proposed_consumables.notes: 211-313 tip code range for trim spray. 211 for narrow boards, 313 for wider fascia/frieze.

proposed_consumables.name: Masking Paper/Film for Glass Protection
proposed_consumables.notes: Masking film or paper for window/door glass adjacent to casings being painted.

proposed_configurations.description: 1 prime + 2 finish coats — standard NC sequence at all QTs
2 finish coats only — when field prime already applied (SS_EXT_PRIMED_FIELD)

proposed_profiles.description: Acrylic exterior primer coverage on trim — 400-450 SF/gal (smooth). LF-based: ~400-450 LF/gal per PCA P10 one-foot rule.
Bonding primer coverage on PVC trim — 350-400 SF/gal. LF equivalent via one-foot rule.
Finish coat coverage on primed exterior trim — 300-400 SF/gal. LF equivalent via one-foot rule.

deduplication_notes: Trim-to-siding joint caulking may also be scoped under siding specs (SF_WOOD_SIDING_EXT_NC_PAINT, SF_SIDING_FIBERCEMENT_EXT_NC). Estimation engine must deduplicate at project assembly (RC-008).
Soffit meets fascia/frieze — soffit spec (SF_SOFFIT_EXT_NC_v1) handles soffit side of junction, this spec handles trim side.
Exterior door slab painting is separate spec (SF_DOOR_EXT_NC_v1). This spec handles door casings only.
Exterior window sash/frame painting is separate spec (SF_WINDOW_EXT_NC_v1). This spec handles window casings and sills only.
Gutter/downspout painting is separate scope (SF_GUTTER_EXT_NC_v1). Gutters mount to fascia but are not in this spec.

proposed_modifiers.applies_to: All tasks on elevated trim components (fascia, rake, frieze, upper-story corner/band boards)
proposed_modifiers.notes: More aggressive than general access modifier because trim requires fine brush detail at height.

cross_file_threading: RULE 1: Every TSK_ in sop_modules.json MUST have a matching rate in production.json
RULE 2: Every ITM_ in spec.json MUST appear in at least one variant
RULE 3: Every SYS_ quality_tier MUST match spec.json configuration_dimensions
RULE 4: Every IN_ input in spec.json SHOULD be consumed by sop_modules or production
RULE 5: Every PS_ key in production.json MUST match spec.json required_paintscope_inputs
RULE 6: Every zone_id in spec.json MUST match sop_modules.json protection_metadata.zones
RULE 7: Module phase order: setup → prep → prime → apply → interstage → finish → cleanup
RULE 8: UOM for a task MUST match between sop_modules.json and production.json
RULE 9: All TSK_ IDs MUST use TSK_XTRM_ prefix (from this resolution)
RULE 10: All ITM_ IDs MUST be used exactly as listed in this resolution's paintable_items
RULE 11: Downstream agents MUST use only enum values from this resolution's applicable_enums

registry_additions_proposed.name: Exterior Trim Finish Coat Coverage
